raw_text: Stack: Spring Boot 4 + WebFlux + Kotlin Coroutines + jOOQ + R2DBC + PostgreSQL. Router (`*Router.kt`): `coRouter { }`; Handler (`*Handler.kt`): suspended, delegates to service; Service (`*Service.kt`): business logic, `<REDACTED_USER>`, `NotFoundException`; Repository (`*Repository.kt`): jOOQ DSL, `Flow<T>`/`suspend`; use `asFlow()`, `awaitFirst/awaitFirstOrNull`. Make all external contracts openapi-generated, place them in contract subproject's resources, place client and model classes in the same package as the base package of the contract owner. IMPORTANT: Always run `./gradlew clean test` on a root project after any changes in contract subproject. Use extension mapping (e.g., `TestTable.toResponse()`).
